guarantees.claim: key_length is assigned the value of key_length_supplied when it matches a defined key length enum (Key_128, Key_256, Key_384, Key_512, Key_1024); for any other value, key_length is assigned Key_None.

assumptions.claim: When key_length = Key_None due to an unsupported key_length_supplied, the external HMAC start logic will block the operation and signal an error to software, preventing the HMAC from using an undefined key length.
assumptions.risk: If the external error logic fails to block, the HMAC could start with Key_None as a valid length, leading to incorrect cryptographic operation or secret leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: This block maps unsupported key lengths to Key_None but does not locally guarantee that the resulting Key_None will be detected and blocked by the HMAC start logic; failure of that external block could allow operation with an invalid key length.
uncertain_points.cond: key_length_supplied is unsupported and the external HMAC start control does not check for Key_None
uncertain_points.risk: HMAC operation with an undefined key length may compromise cryptographic integrity or expose key material.
